subject: Action required: mailbox closes in 30 minutes
body:
Your Smells Phishy Inc. mailbox has exceeded its storage limit.

To avoid losing your email history, verify your username and password immediately using the link below. Do not contact the help desk. This automated process cannot be delayed.

IT Service Desk
explanation: The sender uses smellsphishy-it-help.example instead of our smellsphishy.example domain, and the link leads to another unrelated domain. The threat of immediate closure and instruction not to contact IT add pressure. Use the known company portal or contact IT independently. Never enter credentials through this message.

subject: Updated room for tomorrow's team meeting
body:
Hi team,

Tomorrow's 10 AM operations meeting has moved from Room 204 to Room 206. The agenda is still project updates and next week's staffing.

No action is needed. Your existing calendar invitation has been updated.

Thanks,
Maya
explanation: This routine internal update matches the company domain and asks for no credentials, payment, or unusual action. There are no links or attachments. Approving avoids disrupting ordinary work. A familiar sender alone is not proof of safety. Consider the request and context too.

subject: Your new employee handbook is ready
body:
Welcome to Smells Phishy Inc.,

The employee handbook is available on our internal portal. It covers working hours, leave requests, and office contacts. You can also find it by opening the company portal from your saved bookmark and choosing People > Handbook.

Please review it before Friday.

The People Team
explanation: The sender and destination match the company domain, and this is an expected onboarding request with an independent route through the portal. A deadline by itself does not make a message phishing. Read the full destination rather than relying only on link text.

subject: Payroll correction - confirm your bank details
body:
Dear employee,

We could not process your next salary payment. Confirm your bank account number and portal password today to prevent a delay.

Use the secure payroll form below. Your manager cannot resolve this issue.

Payroll Administration
explanation: The address spells smellsph1shy with a one, and the displayed link text hides a different destination. The request combines banking details and a password with salary pressure. Quarantine it and verify payroll issues through a known internal contact.

subject: Delivery failed: open your shipping receipt
body:
We attempted a delivery to your office today.

Open the attached receipt and run the included delivery tool to schedule another attempt. A storage fee will apply if you do not respond today.

Dispatch Team
explanation: Shipping_Receipt.pdf.exe ends in .exe: it is an executable, not a PDF. An unexpected delivery asking you to run software is suspicious, especially with a fee threat. Do not run it. Verify deliveries using the carrier's independently located website.

subject: Urgent: kitchen closed for water leak
body:
Hello everyone,

A water leak means the second-floor kitchen is closed until tomorrow morning. Please use the first-floor kitchen and keep the hallway clear for maintenance.

If you have questions, call the facilities extension listed in the company directory.

Thank you,
Facilities
explanation: Urgency is a clue to investigate, not automatic proof of phishing. This message gives a plausible workplace instruction, uses the company domain, and directs questions to the established directory. It requests no sensitive data, software installation, or payment.

subject: Benefits overview from orientation
body:
Hello,

Attached is the benefits overview requested during orientation. It summarizes medical plans, paid leave, and enrollment dates. No reply or sign-in is required.

You can also find the same document through the People section of the saved company portal.

Benefits Team
explanation: The sender uses the company domain, the request matches onboarding, and the attachment ends in .pdf rather than a disguised executable. The message asks for no credentials or payment and provides an independent route through the saved company portal. Attachments still require inspection. Context and the final extension support approving this one.

subject: Confidential staffing plan shared with you
body:
A confidential staffing plan has been shared with you.

Sign in with your company email and password before the document expires today. Do not forward this notice or ask the sender for another copy.

Secure Share Notifications
explanation: The display name mentions Morgan, but the sender is on smellsphishy-share.example rather than the company domain. The link leads to another unrelated domain and requests company credentials under time pressure. Verify the request with Morgan through a known channel and quarantine this message.
